name: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from a screen edge, built on Radix UI Dialog primitive. Uses class-variance-authority (CVA) for side variants (top, bottom, left, right). Includes an overlay backdrop, close button, and layout sub-components for header, footer, title, and description.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the sheet.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the open state changes.

props.name: modal
props.description: When true, interaction with outside elements is disabled and only content within the sheet is accessible.

subComponents.name: SheetTrigger
subComponents.description: The element that opens the sheet when clicked. Renders as a Radix Dialog Trigger.

props.name: asChild
props.description: When true, merges props onto the child element.

subComponents.name: SheetClose
subComponents.description: An element that closes the sheet when clicked. Renders as a Radix Dialog Close.

props.name: asChild
props.description: When true, merges props onto the child element.

subComponents.name: SheetPortal
subComponents.description: Portals the sheet content to the document body.

subComponents.name: SheetOverlay
subComponents.description: A fixed full-screen overlay with black/80 background and fade-in/fade-out animations.

subComponents.name: SheetContent
subComponents.description: The main sliding panel. Accepts a 'side' prop for positioning. Automatically renders the overlay and a close (X) button. Animates with slide-in/slide-out transitions. Default width is 3/4 screen (sm:max-w-sm) for left/right sides.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge of the screen from which the sheet slides in.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with CVA variant styles.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to display inside the sheet panel.

subComponents.name: SheetHeader
subComponents.description: A layout wrapper for the sheet header area. Renders a flex column with center-aligned text on mobile and left-aligned on sm+.

subComponents.name: SheetFooter
subComponents.description: A layout wrapper for the sheet footer area. Renders as column-reverse on mobile and row on sm+ with end-justified content.

subComponents.name: SheetTitle
subComponents.description: The title element for the sheet. Rendered as a Radix Dialog Title with text-lg font-semibold styling.

subComponents.name: SheetDescription
subComponents.description: A description element for the sheet. Rendered as a Radix Dialog Description with text-sm muted-foreground styling.

accessibility.keyboard: Escape closes the sheet. Tab traps focus within the sheet content when open. The close button is focusable.
accessibility.aria: Managed by Radix UI Dialog: aria-modal, aria-labelledby (SheetTitle), aria-describedby (SheetDescription). The close button has an sr-only 'Close' label.
accessibility.notes: Always include SheetTitle and SheetDescription inside SheetContent for proper accessible labeling. The overlay click also closes the sheet.

examples.title: Bottom Sheet
examples.code:
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger asChild>
    <Button>Open Bottom</Button>
  </SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="bottom">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Actions</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Choose an action below.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
